title: Planning Role Benchmark Pack
description: Repeatable benchmark task for comparing how local models reprioritize PersonalAI work and produce a grounded next-step plan.

tasks.title: Reprioritize the next PersonalAI development round
tasks.objective: Measure whether the model can read the current project notes, avoid stale roadmap drift, and produce a narrow prioritized plan for the next development round.
tasks.prompt:
Inspect the current PersonalAI project state using the roadmap and MVP notes. Reassess what the next development round should focus on right now.

Requirements:
- stay grounded in the current notes and current implementation state
- do not pretend files were changed, tests were run, or features exist unless the notes support that
- prefer a narrow and sequenced plan over a broad wishlist
- explicitly reprioritize if some previously planned work now has lower value than another task
- optimize for the next real development round, not the long-term vision only

Response goals:
- identify the most important next milestone
- list the next 3 to 5 concrete steps in order
- explain why these steps come before other plausible work
- include validation checkpoints
- keep the plan actionable for a coding agent

Important:
- if benchmark or model-role evaluation should come before a larger feature, say so explicitly
- if planning and implementation should be separated across different models, say how
- do not output code
expected_signals: references current roadmap or current implementation state
reprioritizes instead of repeating a generic wishlist
anti_signals: claims code or tests were executed
ignores current benchmark and evaluation work
notes: Use this task to compare which model is the best fit for planner duty.
